verdict.rationale: Hyperbrowser's docs say agent tasks can be started with a single API call and watched as they execute live. Its rrweb and MP4 recordings support debugging after the run. No evidence shows a human taking control of a session mid-run when the agent gets stuck. The only adjacent capability is a CDP WebSocket endpoint for programmatic control, which is not a human-takeover feature. Missing for 10: documented human takeover or intervention mid-run, details of the live-view interface, independent or hands-on corroboration of live viewing.
